title: Negative $$r$$ points the other way
text: With a negative $$r$$, the point is plotted in the direction opposite to θ. So the angle must point into the second quadrant, opposite the point.

title: Subtract $$\pi$$ from the angle
text: Adding $$\pi$$ to $$\frac{11\pi}{6}$$ would go past $$2\pi$$, so subtract $$\pi$$ instead. That gives $$\theta=\frac{11\pi}{6}-\pi=\frac{5\pi}{6}$$.
